workouts.notes:
Ring Rows

Setup: Rings at waist height. Grab with neutral grip, body straight, heels on floor.
Movement: Pull chest to rings, squeeze shoulder blades, lower with control.
Cues: “Body stays rigid.” “Lead with chest.” “Squeeze at the top.”

Active Hang (Pull-Up Bar)

Setup: Overhand grip, arms straight, body hanging still.
Movement: Pull shoulders down/back (don’t bend arms), hold tight core and legs together.
Cues: “Shoulders away from ears.” “Engage lats.” “Stay tight.”

Banded Pull-Aparts

Setup: Band at shoulder height, arms straight under tension.
Movement: Pull band apart, squeeze shoulder blades, return slow.
Cues: “Arms straight.” “Control the band.” “Pinch shoulder blades.”
